label: KSafe
description: Karoo safety extension on two layers: REACTIVE (crash detection, SOS, check-in, HR-based medical episode and wellness detection) and PREVENTIVE (carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using the Karoo's HR and power zones, reminding you to fuel before bonking or dehydration impairs your judgment on the bike). Sends emergency alerts via WhatsApp (CallMeBot), Telegram, Pushover or ntfy. Beta — test before relying on it.
releaseNotes: Fix behaviour (FP) when there are some jumps and biker is upside (more than 15 degrees). Added calories burned (HR) and exported to FIT. Stream custom fields. Improved detection of normal braking stops to reduce false alarms. Fix wellness bpm. Now available in Spanish. Per-profile crash detection settings. Per-contact alert filtering. New combined fuel field. Two more webhook action fields (now 4 total) to trigger HTTP actions mid-ride. Plus reliability fixes across emergency delivery and configuration handling.
